items.description: Select a payment method and enter your payment details.
Once payment is complete, your voucher is issued immediately.

You can check purchased vouchers in My Shopping,
and also receive them on LINE by adding Unifi as a friend.
Once your payment is confirmed, you also receive 5% cashback as points.

sections.title: Cancellation & Refund
items: Please check the cancellation and refund terms for each product before purchase.
Unused vouchers can be fully refunded within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period or if the voucher has been partially used.
